tasks.description:
Replace the hand-rolled session cookie with the shared token service. The old cookie is issued in three different places and none of them agree on expiry.

Definition of done:

  • One issuing path, covered by tests
  • Expiry read from config, not hard-coded
  • Old cookie name still accepted for one release

See the ADR for the agreed contract.

raid.title: Legacy user data corruption during migration
raid.description:
50k bcrypt-hashed passwords move in this migration. A corrupted batch would lock users out of every connected service at once, not just login.

Worst realistic case is a partial write we do not notice until the next business day.
raid.mitigation: Pre-migration backup + 5k-batch dry-runs with rollback markers. Weekly integrity checks during cutover week.

noteLog.html: Dry-runs of batches 1–3 came back clean and the integrity checks are green; marking this mitigated.
noteLog.text: Dry-runs of batches 1–3 came back clean and the integrity checks are green; marking this mitigated.

raid.title: SSO provider outage during peak hours
raid.description: Vendor-side downtime would block all logins for all users.
raid.mitigation: Provider SLA: 99.95%. Fallback: temporary local-account bypass for ops accounts (documented, time-boxed).

noteLog.html: Vendor SLA call scheduled; requesting a 99.95% uptime commitment for peak windows.
noteLog.text: Vendor SLA call scheduled; requesting a 99.95% uptime commitment for peak windows.

raid.title: Performance regression on login under load
raid.description: Auth path adds 200ms p95 latency vs baseline; could degrade homepage TTFB.
raid.mitigation: Token verification cached; index added on session lookup. Still monitoring.

noteLog.html: p95 is back under 120 ms after the session-index fix. Keeping it open until the load test confirms.
noteLog.text: p95 is back under 120 ms after the session-index fix. Keeping it open until the load test confirms.

raid.description: SameSite=Strict cookie + cross-origin redirect chain triggers Safari ITP loop — surfaced in testing.
raid.mitigation: Workaround in dev: SameSite=Lax. Need security review before prod.

changes.title: Add MFA to SSO scope
changes.description: Extend the current SSO implementation to require multi-factor authentication (TOTP / push) for all privileged accounts before production go-live. Driven by updated InfoSec policy issued this quarter.
changes.impactDescription:
Adds roughly three weeks of backend and frontend work, and pulls in a second security review cycle.

  1. Backend: TOTP enrolment + verification endpoints
  2. Frontend: enrolment flow and recovery-code screen
  3. Re-scope the load-test scenarios to include the MFA step
